itinerary.labelHtml:
The Itinerary

Day by day

Swipe each carousel for photos. Every stop carries cost, June air and sea temps, a money-saving tip, a splurge, picky-kid restaurants, backup / if-time ideas, travel links, and a map.

days.heading: Depart Pittsburgh after work
days.note: No direct PIT-Europe flight. Keep this on one ticket if the price is close; checked bags and missed-connection protection matter with kids.

days.heading: Arrive Sardinia → Alghero base

facts.label: Car
facts.valueHtml: Pick up Sardinia rental at OLB/AHO

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Check in, old-town walk, easy beach/pool

days.note: Best arrival airport is Olbia or Alghero if fares cooperate; Cagliari works but adds a long first-day drive.

spots.name: Alghero old town & Bastioni
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · AlgheroIG · BastioniFlickr

images.alt: Alghero old town seawall at sunset
The Escala del Cabirol staircase cut into Capo Caccia's cliffs
Bosa riverside town

spots.cost: Old town free; ramparts walk free; gelato/snacks €12-25 family; parking €1-2/hr near the port.
spots.climate: 79°F day / 64°F night. Sea 72-73°F — the key fix vs Portugal: warm enough for real kid swims in sheltered bays.
spots.saveHtml: Save Sleep just outside the ZTL and walk in; avoids old-town parking stress and €20-30/day garage costs.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Book one sunset sailing or snorkel trip from Alghero, typically €45-75 pp in June.
spots.restoHtml:
• Fratelli Bizzarro — pizza/pasta, casual, ~€10-18 pp, strong pizza reviews; plain margherita works.
  • Faineria da Nino — budget faina/focaccia/pizza slices, ~€6-12 pp, easy snack dinner.
  • Mabrouk — set seafood/pasta menu for parents; kids can stick to simple pasta.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Bosa day trip ↗ — painted riverside town about 55 min south; a town-heavy alternate if wind spoils the beach.
  • Bosa ↗ — painted riverside town about an hour south; a town-heavy alternate if wind spoils the beach.
  • Mugoni Beach ↗ — pine-backed, calmer family beach near Capo Caccia.

days.heading: Capo Caccia + Neptune's Grotto

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Capo Caccia, Neptune's Grotto, Mugoni/Porto Conte swim

days.note: Do the cave early, then make the afternoon about water. If the sea is rough, use the stair route or skip the cave and beach-hop.

spots.name: Capo Caccia & Neptune's Grotto
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · Capo CacciaIG · Neptune's GrottoFlickr

images.alt: Capo Caccia's 200-meter limestone cliffs seen from the water, with the lighthouse above
Alghero's Bastioni seawall lined with café umbrellas at midday
Torre della Pelosa under a moody sky with seabirds overhead

spots.cost: Viewpoints free. Neptune's Grotto: roughly €14 adult / €10 child plus boat or 654-step Escala del Cabirol.
spots.climate: 79°F day / 64°F night. Sea 72-73°F — pleasant in sheltered coves, but the cave itself is not a swim stop.
spots.saveHtml: Save Use the stairs if knees and heat are reasonable; skip boat fares and control timing.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Private dinghy or small-group snorkel around Capo Caccia, about €55-90 pp.
spots.restoHtml:
• Fratelli Bizzarro — pizza/pasta, casual, ~€10-18 pp, strong pizza reviews; plain margherita works.
  • Faineria da Nino — budget faina/focaccia/pizza slices, ~€6-12 pp, easy snack dinner.
  • Mabrouk — set seafood/pasta menu for parents; kids can stick to simple pasta.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Mugoni Beach ↗ — pine-backed, calmer family beach nearby when the cave feels too touristy.
  • Le Saline Beach ↗ — less famous and easier than La Pelosa while keeping clear water.
  • Maria Pia Beach ↗ — pine-shaded sand close to Alghero when old-town heat builds.
spots.bloglinksHtml: Sardinia by Locals — Neptune's Cave ↗Strictly Sardinia — Capo Caccia ↗

days.heading: La Pelosa or Bosa choice day
days.feel: Big north-coast beach or colorful town

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Timed La Pelosa slot, or Bosa if beach permits/wind are bad

days.note: La Pelosa is the north-coast swim card. Book the slot once 2027 rules open; bring required mats under towels.

spots.name: La Pelosa / Stintino beach day
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · La PelosaIG · StintinoFlickr

images.alt: La Pelosa beach and Aragonese tower
Golden-hour view from atop Alghero's ramparts over the old town rooftops
Capo Caccia's cliffs and Isola Foradada backlit at sunset

spots.cost: Timed-entry beach rules usually run June-Oct: cap around 1,500/day, ticket about €3.50 pp age 12+, mat under towels required; parking extra.
spots.climate: 79°F day / 64°F night. Sea 72-73°F — shallow turquoise water is one of the best kid-swim setups in north Sardinia.
spots.saveHtml: Save If La Pelosa slots are gone, use nearby Le Saline or Ezzi Mannu for free beach time.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Reserve loungers/umbrella early, roughly €35-60/day, to avoid fighting for shade.
spots.restoHtml:
• Fratelli Bizzarro — pizza/pasta, casual, ~€10-18 pp, strong pizza reviews; plain margherita works.
  • Faineria da Nino — budget faina/focaccia/pizza slices, ~€6-12 pp, easy snack dinner.
  • Mabrouk — set seafood/pasta menu for parents; kids can stick to simple pasta.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Le Saline Beach ↗ — less famous, easier parking, still clear water and room for kids to spread out.
  • Maria Pia Beach ↗ — pine-shaded sand close to Alghero when old-town heat builds.
  • Bosa ↗ — painted riverside town about an hour south; a town-heavy alternate if wind spoils the beach.
spots.bloglinksHtml: Strictly Sardinia — La Pelosa rules ↗Sardinia Unlimited — Stintino beaches ↗

days.heading: Drive Alghero → Bonifacio via ferry

facts.label: Car
facts.valueHtml: Park Sardinia rental at Santa Teresa; foot ferry unless contract allows car

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Drive 2h15 to Santa Teresa, 50-min ferry, Bonifacio evening

days.note: This is the Portugal plan's Faro→Madeira-style scenery change, but easier: the Strait crossing is under an hour.

spots.name: Santa Teresa Gallura → Bonifacio ferry
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · Santa Teresa GalluraIG · BonifacioFlickr

images.alt: Bonifacio marina and old town
The chalk-white cliffs of Bonifacio and the freestanding Grain de Sable rock rising from turquoise water
Lavezzi Islands near Bonifacio

spots.cost: 2026 route: 50-60 min. Typical family foot-passenger round trip budget €220-360; with car often €450-650+ round trip, and rental-company permission is the gating item.
spots.climate: 78°F day / 63°F night. Sea 72-74°F — the crossing itself is short; beach swimming waits for Corsica.
spots.saveHtml: Save Do not ferry the Sardinia rental unless the contract explicitly allows Italy-France ferry travel; park in Santa Teresa and go as foot passengers.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Pay for flex tickets and an earlier sailing so a windy Strait delay does not wreck the transfer day.
spots.restoHtml:
• La Bodega — traditional near citadel, €10-25 pp; Corsica Lovers flags it as child-suitable.
  • La Place — brasserie/pizza/burgers, ~€15-25 pp, 4.3★ TripAdvisor.
  • Le Bastion — family-rated old-town restaurant, ~€20-35 pp; fries and simple mains available.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Maddalena day trip ↗ — stay in Sardinia and swap Corsica for La Maddalena if ferry prices or rental rules get ugly.
  • Maria Pia Beach ↗ — pine-shaded sand close to Alghero when old-town heat builds.
  • Bosa ↗ — painted riverside town about an hour south; a town-heavy alternate if wind spoils the beach.
spots.bloglinksHtml: Ichnusa Lines — ferry with kids ↗Direct Ferries — live route pricing ↗
spots.spotMapHtml: 📍 Open in Google Maps ↗

spots.name: Bonifacio clifftop old town
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · BonifacioFlickr

images.alt: Bonifacio's chalk cliffs
Bonifacio's marina at golden hour, sailboats reflected in still water below the citadel
Sailboats anchored in the turquoise lagoon of the Lavezzi Islands, granite boulders in the foreground

spots.cost: Old town free. King Aragon Steps often about €5 adult / €2.50 child; tourist train around €6-8 pp.
spots.climate: 78°F day / 63°F night. Sea 72-74°F — good for swimming in nearby bays; old town is the town/history beat.
spots.saveHtml: Save Sleep near the marina/port and skip a Corsica car for the town day; everything is walkable but steep.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Boat under the cliffs and sea caves, roughly €25-40 pp for the classic one-hour circuit.
spots.restoHtml:
• La Bodega — traditional near citadel, €10-25 pp; Corsica Lovers flags it as child-suitable.
  • La Place — brasserie/pizza/burgers, ~€15-25 pp, 4.3★ TripAdvisor.
  • Le Bastion — family-rated old-town restaurant, ~€20-35 pp; fries and simple mains available.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Porto-Vecchio old town ↗ — more resort-town energy, bigger restaurant pool, about 35 min if you rent a car.
  • Santa Giulia Beach ↗ — wide, shallow, family-friendly beach if Rondinara is too busy.
  • Lavezzi Islands ↗ — boat-day alternative for clear water if beach parking is the problem.
spots.bloglinksHtml: Corsica Lovers — Bonifacio restaurants ↗Bonifacio Tourist Office — family vacation ↗
spots.spotMapHtml: 📍 Open in Google Maps ↗

days.heading: Bonifacio beach + cliffs

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Rondinara or Petit Sperone, old town at golden hour

days.note: Without a Corsica rental, use taxi/boat and stay focused. If renting locally, book early; supply near Bonifacio is thin.

spots.name: Rondinara or Petit Sperone beach
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · RondinaraIG · Petit SperoneFlickr

images.alt: Rondinara Bay turquoise water
Petit Sperone beach near Bonifacio, turquoise cove framed by a pine-covered headland
Looking up from the sea at Bonifacio's houses perched along the clifftop edge

spots.cost: Beach free; parking often €5-10/day in season; taxi or short rental car day if staying car-free.
spots.climate: 78°F day / 63°F night. Sea 72-74°F — sheltered water and pale sand make this the Corsica kid-swim day.
spots.saveHtml: Save Choose one beach and stay put; Corsica beach-hopping burns money in taxis and parking.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Half-day Lavezzi Islands boat from Bonifacio, about €45-75 pp, for the big turquoise-water hit.
spots.restoHtml:
• La Bodega — traditional near citadel, €10-25 pp; Corsica Lovers flags it as child-suitable.
  • La Place — brasserie/pizza/burgers, ~€15-25 pp, 4.3★ TripAdvisor.
  • Le Bastion — family-rated old-town restaurant, ~€20-35 pp; fries and simple mains available.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Santa Giulia Beach ↗ — wide, shallow, very family-friendly, but busier and farther from Bonifacio.
  • Porto-Vecchio old town ↗ — bigger restaurant pool and polished evening scene about 35 minutes from Bonifacio.
  • Lavezzi Islands ↗ — boat-day alternative for clear water if beach parking is the problem.
spots.bloglinksHtml: Corsica Lovers — Rondinara ↗The Sandy Feet — Bonifacio beaches ↗

days.heading: Ferry back → Ogliastra base

facts.label: Sleep
facts.valueHtml: Santa Maria Navarrese / Baunei · night 1 of 4

facts.label: Car
facts.valueHtml: Recover Sardinia rental in Santa Teresa

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Ferry back, drive 3h to Ogliastra, Pedra Longa sunset

days.note: This is the biggest road day after the ferry. Keep the stop simple: Pedra Longa views, pizza dinner, early bed.

spots.name: Pedra Longa & Santa Maria Navarrese
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · Pedra LongaIG · Santa Maria NavarreseFlickr

images.alt: Pedra Longa limestone pinnacle from the trail above
Golden-hour view of the historic watchtower at Santa Maria Navarrese, framed by oleander
Rocce Rosse, Arbatax

spots.cost: Free viewpoint/swim rocks; parking usually free/low cost. Short walks rather than committing to Selvaggio Blu.
spots.climate: 81°F day / 66°F night. Sea 73-75°F — east coast water is the swim payoff the Portugal Atlantic could not deliver.
spots.saveHtml: Save Use Pedra Longa as the free cliff-meets-sea substitute for a paid all-day boat if weather is iffy.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Dinner with a sea view in Santa Maria Navarrese, €25-40 adult mains, while kids get pizza.
spots.restoHtml:
• MeC Puddu's — Santa Maria Navarrese pizzeria/Italian, ~€10-20 pp; pizza, pasta, fries.
  • Ristorante Il Pozzo — Italian/pizza/seafood, ~€12-25 pp; reviewers mention pizza and hungry-kid friendliness.
  • Shardana — pizzeria/Italian, ~€12-22 pp; good fallback for plain pizza and pasta.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Lido di Orri ↗ — wide sandy beach near Tortoli for an easier pure-swim afternoon.
  • Cala Mariolu by boat ↗ — same Gulf of Orosei wow water with less hiking commitment.
  • Cala Luna ↗ — larger beach with caves, easier for a longer sit if kids tire of moving.
spots.bloglinksHtml: Strictly Sardinia — Baunei coast ↗Sardinia Mood — Ogliastra guide ↗
spots.spotMapHtml: 📍 Open in Google Maps ↗

days.heading: Cala Goloritze hike + swim

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Early Cala Goloritze hike, beach swim, slow dinner

days.note: This is the hardest day in the plan. Moving one day earlier keeps the same weather band, but it makes the early start even more important for heat and kid patience.

spots.name: Cala Goloritze hike / booking day
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · Cala GoloritzeFlickr

images.alt: Cala Goloritze cove from above
Pedra Longa's pinnacle seen from the switchback coastal road below
Turquoise waves breaking over pink pebbles at Cala Mariolu

spots.cost: 2026-style rules: book ahead via Heart of Sardinia; typical hike ticket €7 pp, daily cap around 250, trail opens 7:30 and closes 14:00; beach stay until late afternoon.
spots.climate: 81°F day / 66°F night. Sea 73-75°F — clear and swimmable, but the hike out is hot; start early with the 8-year-old.
spots.saveHtml: Save Book the hike instead of a boat landing; the trail ticket is far cheaper and avoids boat crowds.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Hire a local guide for the hike or switch to a small-group Gulf of Orosei boat if heat spikes.
spots.restoHtml:
• MeC Puddu's — Santa Maria Navarrese pizzeria/Italian, ~€10-20 pp; pizza, pasta, fries.
  • Ristorante Il Pozzo — Italian/pizza/seafood, ~€12-25 pp; reviewers mention pizza and hungry-kid friendliness.
  • Shardana — pizzeria/Italian, ~€12-22 pp; good fallback for plain pizza and pasta.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Cala Mariolu by boat ↗ — same Gulf of Orosei wow water with less hiking; book landing QR rules if required.
  • Cala Luna ↗ — larger beach with caves, easier for a longer sit if kids tire of moving.
  • Supramonte viewpoint picnic ↗ — nature scenery without committing to a long canyon hike.

days.heading: Gulf of Orosei boat day · Juneteenth observed

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Cala Mariolu / Cala Luna / swim stops by boat

days.note: Book a smaller boat from Santa Maria Navarrese or Arbatax and confirm which beaches need QR landing tickets under 2027 rules. Juneteenth is observed today, so this is the free PTO day inside the corrected route.

spots.name: Gulf of Orosei boat: Cala Mariolu / Cala Luna
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · Cala MarioluIG · Cala LunaFlickr

images.alt: Gulf of Orosei limestone coastline near Cala Mariolu
Cala Goloritze's turquoise cove and natural arch seen from the headland above
Pedra Longa's pinnacle rising straight out of the teal water, seen from a boat

spots.cost: Shared boat from Arbatax/Santa Maria Navarrese often €45-75 pp; beach landing/access QR rules apply to regulated Baunei beaches.
spots.climate: 81°F day / 66°F night. Sea 73-75°F — best water day of the route; bring water shoes for pebbles.
spots.saveHtml: Save Pack lunch and drinks; boat-day beach kiosks are limited and expensive.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Private dinghy with skipper, roughly €350-600 family depending boat/time, to control swim stops.
spots.restoHtml:
• MeC Puddu's — Santa Maria Navarrese pizzeria/Italian, ~€10-20 pp; pizza, pasta, fries.
  • Ristorante Il Pozzo — Italian/pizza/seafood, ~€12-25 pp; reviewers mention pizza and hungry-kid friendliness.
  • Shardana — pizzeria/Italian, ~€12-22 pp; good fallback for plain pizza and pasta.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Cala Luna ↗ — larger beach with caves, easier for a long sit if kids tire of moving.
  • Supramonte viewpoint picnic ↗ — nature scenery without committing to a long canyon hike.
  • Cala Gonone Aquarium ↗ — compact indoor/kid backup if boat weather fails.

days.heading: Gorropu-light or beach buffer

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Short canyon/viewpoint version, then beach/pool reset

days.note: Keep this easier than a full Selvaggio Blu-adjacent day. Heat and cliff exposure matter more than mileage.

spots.name: Gorropu easy canyon edge / Dorgali
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · GorropuIG · DorgaliFlickr

images.alt: Golden light on the towering striated walls of the Gorropu gorge
Pedra Longa's twin rock spires against the sky, with the trail switchbacking below
Straight-down aerial view of Cala Goloritze's beach and turquoise water

spots.cost: Gorropu access commonly ~€6 pp; jeep shuttles extra. For kids, do a shorter canyon-edge version, not an all-day sufferfest.
spots.climate: 82°F day / 65°F night. Sea 73-75°F — not a swim stop; pair with a late pool or Santa Maria Navarrese beach reset.
spots.saveHtml: Save Do a short out-and-back viewpoint walk and save the paid jeep for hotter or tired legs.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Guided family canyon hike, roughly €45-70 pp, for route-finding and safety.
spots.restoHtml:
• MeC Puddu's — Santa Maria Navarrese pizzeria/Italian, ~€10-20 pp; pizza, pasta, fries.
  • Ristorante Il Pozzo — Italian/pizza/seafood, ~€12-25 pp; reviewers mention pizza and hungry-kid friendliness.
  • Shardana — pizzeria/Italian, ~€12-22 pp; good fallback for plain pizza and pasta.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Supramonte viewpoint picnic ↗ — nature scenery without committing the 8-year-old to a long canyon hike.
  • Cala Gonone Aquarium ↗ — compact indoor/kid backup if boat weather fails.
  • Lido di Orri ↗ — wide sandy beach near Tortoli for an easier pure-swim afternoon.

days.heading: Drive Ogliastra → Cagliari
days.note: Cagliari gives the trip a town-and-food finish while keeping Poetto beach minutes away.

spots.name: Cagliari Castello & Bastione
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · Cagliari CastelloIG · BastioneFlickr

images.alt: Bastione San Remy, Cagliari
Poetto beach shoreline with the Sella del Diavolo headland beyond
Nora ruins with the Coltellazzo watchtower on its seaside peninsula

spots.cost: Old town free. Bastione free; towers/museums usually €3-10 pp. Parking garages near Marina/Castello €1.50-2.50/hr.
spots.climate: 84°F day / 68°F night. Sea 73-75°F — south coast is reliably warm enough for kid swimming.
spots.saveHtml: Save Use one paid garage and walk the old town instead of chasing street parking in heat.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Rooftop aperitivo or guided food walk, about €40-75 pp for adults; kids can split pizza after.
spots.restoHtml:
• Pizzeria Cerere — top family-pizza pick, ~€10-18 pp, plain pizza safety net.
  • Bombas — local burgers/fries, ~€10-18 pp; the burger stop for the picky kid.
  • Caprizza Cagliari — family-friendly pizzeria, ~€10-20 pp; easy Marina/Castello dinner.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Molentargius flamingo park ↗ — flat bike/walk with flamingos if the old town feels too hot.
  • Chia beaches ↗ — dune-backed beach payoff west of Pula if ruins get voted down.
  • Nora ruins ↗ — coastal ruins plus Pula gelato if you want history with beach access nearby.

days.heading: Poetto beach + flamingos

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Poetto, Sella del Diavolo, optional Molentargius flamingos

days.note: A deliberately easy day after Ogliastra. City beach, shallow water, predictable restaurants.

spots.name: Poetto beach + Sella del Diavolo
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · PoettoIG · Sella del DiavoloFlickr

images.alt: Poetto beach at dusk with Sella del Diavolo
Aerial night view straight down the Bastione San Remy's curved grand staircase
The historic watchtower above Porto Giunco's turquoise cove, Villasimius

spots.cost: Beach free; lidos rent umbrellas/loungers roughly €20-40/day. Easy bus/taxi from center; parking easier early.
spots.climate: 84°F day / 68°F night. Sea 73-75°F — long shallow city beach, a proper swim day 10 minutes from town.
spots.saveHtml: Save Use the free beach sections and buy snacks from supermarkets/kiosks instead of a full lido day.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Reserve front-row lido chairs or do SUP/kayak rental, roughly €15-25/hr.
spots.restoHtml:
• Pizzeria Cerere — top family-pizza pick, ~€10-18 pp, plain pizza safety net.
  • Bombas — local burgers/fries, ~€10-18 pp; the burger stop for the picky kid.
  • Caprizza Cagliari — family-friendly pizzeria, ~€10-20 pp; easy Marina/Castello dinner.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Calamosca ↗ — smaller protected cove when Poetto is windy or too busy.
  • Nora ruins ↗ — coastal ruins plus Pula gelato if you want history with beach access nearby.
  • Molentargius flamingo park ↗ — flat bike/walk with flamingos when the old town feels too hot.

days.heading: Villasimius or Nora final choice
days.feel: Last big beach or ruins + beach

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Porto Giunco beach, or Nora + Pula if the family wants history

days.note: Pick based on weather and appetite: Porto Giunco for pure water, Nora for a calmer ruins-and-swim mix.

spots.name: Porto Giunco / Villasimius beach day
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · Porto GiuncoIG · VillasimiusFlickr

images.alt: Porto Giunco lagoon and beach, Villasimius
Golden-hour lifeguard station and rescue boat on Poetto beach
Detailed Roman mosaic floor at the Nora archaeological site

spots.cost: Beach free; parking often €5-10/day; umbrellas/loungers €25-45/day in June.
spots.climate: 84°F day / 68°F night. Sea 73-75°F — shallow, clear, and family-friendly; one of the south coast's strongest beach days.
spots.saveHtml: Save Arrive before 9:30, park once, and make this the whole day rather than paying multiple lots.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Boat/snorkel trip in Capo Carbonara marine area, about €45-80 pp.
spots.restoHtml:
• Pizzeria Cerere — top family-pizza pick, ~€10-18 pp, plain pizza safety net.
  • Bombas — local burgers/fries, ~€10-18 pp; the burger stop for the picky kid.
  • Caprizza Cagliari — family-friendly pizzeria, ~€10-20 pp; easy Marina/Castello dinner.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Nora / Chia ↗ — ruins plus beach south-west of Cagliari if you want more history than beach.
  • Molentargius flamingo park ↗ — flat bike/walk with flamingos when the old town feels too hot.
  • Calamosca ↗ — smaller protected cove when Poetto is windy or too busy.

spots.name: Nora ruins + Pula gelato
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · NoraIG · PulaFlickr

images.alt: Nora ruins
Rows of beach umbrellas leading to the sea at Poetto
Looking up the Bastione San Remy staircase past palm trees, Cagliari

spots.cost: Nora archaeological area often ~€8 adult / reduced kids; parking/beach nearby low cost. Good half-day before packing.
spots.climate: 84°F day / 68°F night. Sea 73-75°F — ruins sit beside swimmable water, so history can still end in a dip.
spots.saveHtml: Save Pair Nora with the free beach rather than adding another paid attraction.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Guided archaeological tour or late seafood dinner in Pula, €30-45 adult mains.
spots.restoHtml:
• Pizzeria Cerere — top family-pizza pick, ~€10-18 pp, plain pizza safety net.
  • Bombas — local burgers/fries, ~€10-18 pp; the burger stop for the picky kid.
  • Caprizza Cagliari — family-friendly pizzeria, ~€10-20 pp; easy Marina/Castello dinner.
spots.altboxHtml:
• Chia beaches ↗ — dune-backed, west of Pula; bigger beach payoff if ruins get voted down.
  • Calamosca ↗ — smaller protected cove when Poetto is windy or too busy.
  • Molentargius flamingo park ↗ — flat bike/walk with flamingos when the old town feels too hot.

}
main{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:56px clamp(18px,5vw,60px) 40px}
.section-label{text-align:center;margin:0 auto 40px;max-width:760px}

.section-label p{margin:0;color:var(--muted)}
.divider{margin:78px 0 40px}
/* OVERVIEW */
.overview{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:18px;margin-bottom:26px}
.ocard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.ocard .eyebrow{color:var(--c1)}
.ocard h4{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:600}
.ocard p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem}
/* TRIP MAP */
.hc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:18px}
.hc{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:20px 22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-top:4px solid var(--muted)}
.hc.actnow{border-top-color:#c0392b}
.hc.watch{border-top-color:var(--gold)}
.hc.good{border-top-color:var(--c3)}
.hc-tag{display:inline-block;font-size:.66rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:999px;margin-bottom:10px;color:#fff}
.hc.actnow .hc-tag{background:#c0392b}
.hc.watch .hc-tag{background:var(--gold)}
.hc.good .hc-tag{background:var(--c3)}
.hc h4{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.15}
.hc p{margin:0;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5}
.hc p b{color:var(--ink)}

/* TRAVEL TIPS */
.tips-order{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:18px 20px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);margin-bottom:22px}
.tips-order p.mini-h{margin:0 0 12px}
.tips-order ol{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;counter-reset:step}
.tips-order li{counter-increment:step;position:relative;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:7px 14px 7px 30px;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600}
.tips-order li::before{content:counter(step);position:absolute;left:6px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c1);color:#fff;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:800;display:grid;place-items:center}
.tips-order li span{color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.tips-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(340px,1fr));gap:18px}
.tipcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:20px 22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-top:4px solid var(--c1)}
.tipcard.t2{border-top-color:var(--c2)}.tipcard.t3{border-top-color:var(--gold)}.tipcard.t4{border-top-color:var(--c3)}
.tipcard h4{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:600}
.tipcard .sub{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:.74rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.tipcard ul{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;display:grid;gap:11px}
.tipcard li{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5;padding-left:16px;position:relative}
.tipcard li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:8px;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold)}
.tipcard li b{color:var(--ink)}
.tipcard li.flag::before{background:#c0392b;width:8px;height:8px;top:7px}
.tipcard li.flag b{color:#b5361f}

.daycost{display:inline-block;margin:8px 0 0;font-size:.76rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--c2);background:rgba(194,90,58,.1);border:1px solid rgba(194,90,58,.28);border-radius:999px;padding:3px 11px}
.budget-tbl.grand tr.total td{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:800}
.rate-note{margin:12px 2px 0;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5}

.kv.climate{margin-top:10px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
.kv.climate span{color:var(--c1)}

/* TIMING COMPARE */
.timing-compare{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:18px;margin-bottom:22px}
.tcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:20px 22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-top:4px solid var(--muted)}
.tcard.now{border-top-color:var(--c1)}
.tcard.later{border-top-color:var(--c2)}
.tcard.best{border-top-color:var(--c3)}
.tcard.best .tlabel{background:var(--c3)}
.tcard .tlabel{display:inline-block;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px;margin-bottom:10px;color:#fff}
.tcard.now .tlabel{background:var(--c1)}
.tcard.later .tlabel{background:var(--c2)}
.tcard h4{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:600}
.tcard .trow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.88rem}
.tcard .trow:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.tcard .trow span{color:var(--muted)}
.tcard .trow strong{text-align:right}
.tcard .trow strong.bad{color:#b5361f}
.listcard.pro-list{border-top:4px solid var(--c3)}
.listcard.con-list{border-top:4px solid #c0392b}
.listcard.pro-list li::before{content:"✓";position:static;width:auto;height:auto;border-radius:0;background:none;color:var(--c3);font-weight:800;margin-right:6px}
.listcard.con-list li::before{content:"✗";position:static;width:auto;height:auto;border-radius:0;background:none;color:#c0392b;font-weight:800;margin-right:6px}
.listcard.pro-list li,.listcard.con-list li{padding-left:0;display:flex;gap:2px}
.listcard.pro-list li>span,.listcard.con-list li>span{flex:1}
.verdict-box{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:14px;padding:20px 22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);margin-top:20px}
.verdict-box h4{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:800}
.verdict-box p{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.55}
.verdict-box p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.verdict-box .aside{font-size:.82rem;font-style:italic;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);padding-top:10px;margin-top:12px}

.tripmap-wrap{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.mapbtns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px}
.mapbtns button{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;font-size:.82rem;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s}
.mapbtns button:hover{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.mapbtns button .sw{display:inline-block;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:6px;vertical-align:middle}
#tripmap{height:460px;border-radius:14px;z-index:1}
.leaflet-popup-content{font:14px/1.4 "Inter",sans-serif}
.leaflet-popup-content b{font-family:"Fraunces",serif}
.pin{width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
/* BASES */
.bases{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:20px}
.base{position:relative;background:var(--card);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.base .band{height:6px}
.base.b1 .band{background:var(--c1)}.base.b2 .band{background:var(--c2)}.base.b3 .band{background:var(--c3)}

.base .bbody{padding:18px 20px 22px}

.base h4{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:1.55rem;font-weight:600}
.base .dates{margin:0 0 10px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem;font-weight:600}
.base p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem}
.base .book{margin:12px 0 0;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.82rem;color:var(--ink)}
.base .book b{color:var(--c2)}
/* PLAN GRID */
.plan-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px}
.pcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:22px 24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.pcard h4{margin:0 0 14px;font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:600;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.pcard h4 .dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold)}
.prow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.9rem}
.prow:last-of-type{border-bottom:0}
.prow span{color:var(--muted)}.prow strong{text-align:right}
.pcard .tip{margin:12px 0 0;padding:10px 12px;background:rgba(217,164,65,.12);border-radius:10px;font-size:.82rem;color:#8a6a1e}

.day-title h3{margin:2px 0 4px;font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.05}

.logistics{padding:4px 24px 12px}

.facts div:last-child{border-bottom:0}

.facts strong{font-weight:600}
.note{margin:0;color:var(--ink);font-size:.94rem;line-height:1.55}
/* SPOTS */
.spots-wrap{display:grid;gap:20px;padding:6px 24px 24px}
.travel-note{padding:40px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:14px;font-weight:600}
.spot{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper)}
.spot-head{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:14px 16px}
.spot-name{margin:0;font-size:1.22rem;font-weight:600}
.explore{display:flex;gap:6px;flex:0 1 auto;min-width:0;max-width:100%;overflow-x:auto;overscroll-behavior-x:contain;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;scrollbar-width:none}

.explore a:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.explore .xg{background:#4285F4}
.explore .xi{background:linear-gradient(45deg,#f09433,#dc2743 55%,#bc1888)}
.explore .xf{background:#0063dc}

.carousel{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#e7e1d4}
.track{display:flex;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scroll-behavior:smooth;scrollbar-width:none}
.track::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.track figure{margin:0;flex:0 0 100%;scroll-snap-align:center;position:relative}
.track img{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/2;object-fit:cover;background:#e7e1d4}
.track figcaption{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:26px 14px 10px;color:#fff;font-size:.74rem;line-height:1.3;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,rgba(0,0,0,.68))}
.track figcaption strong{display:block;font-weight:700}
.track figcaption span{color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);font-size:.66rem}
.nav{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.86);color:var(--ink);font-size:1.4rem;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.25);transition:.15s;z-index:2}
.nav:hover{background:#fff;transform:translateY(-50%) scale(1.08)}
.nav.prev{left:12px}.nav.next{right:12px}
.counter{position:absolute;top:12px;right:12px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);color:#fff;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;z-index:2}
.dots{position:absolute;bottom:10px;left:0;right:0;display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:6px;z-index:2;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:0 40px}
.dots .dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.5);cursor:pointer;padding:0;transition:.15s}
.dots .dot.on{background:#fff;width:20px;border-radius:999px}

.spot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(0,.85fr);gap:18px;padding:16px}
.mini-h{margin:0 0 6px;font-weight:800;font-size:.76rem;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.kv{margin-bottom:12px}
.kv span{font-weight:800;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--ink)}
.kv p{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted)}
.callout{border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:.86rem;margin-bottom:10px;line-height:1.45}

.callout.splurge{background:rgba(217,164,65,.14);border-left:3px solid var(--splurge)}

.resto li a{text-decoration:none}.resto li b{color:var(--ink)}
.altbox{margin:14px 0 4px;padding:12px;background:rgba(31,111,120,.07);border-radius:10px}
.altbox p:last-child{margin:0;font-size:.86rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.45}
.altbox a{text-decoration:none}
.bloglinks{margin-top:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.bloglinks a{font-size:.83rem;text-decoration:none;color:var(--c1);font-weight:600}
.bloglinks a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.spot-map{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.mapwrap{position:relative;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line);flex:1;min-height:240px}
.gmap{width:100%;height:100%;min-height:240px;border:0;display:block}
.gmap-btn{margin-top:10px;text-align:center;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;font-size:.85rem;padding:10px;border-radius:10px;transition:.15s}
.gmap-btn:hover{background:var(--c1)}

.budget-tbl th{background:rgba(31,111,120,.08);font-family:"Fraunces",serif;font-weight:600}
.budget-tbl td:last-child,.budget-tbl th:last-child{text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
.budget-tbl tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0;font-weight:700}
.budget-scroll{overflow-x:auto}
.twocol{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;margin-top:22px}
.listcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:20px 22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.listcard h4{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:600}
.listcard.save-list{border-top:4px solid var(--save)}
.listcard.splurge-list{border-top:4px solid var(--splurge)}
.listcard ul{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;display:grid;gap:10px}
.listcard li{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.45;padding-left:22px;position:relative}
.save-list li::before{content:"💰";position:absolute;left:0;top:0}
.splurge-list li::before{content:"✨";position:absolute;left:0;top:0}
.listcard li b{color:var(--ink)}
/* BALANCE */
.bar{height:10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(26,23,18,.08);overflow:hidden;margin:14px 0 24px;display:flex}
.bar i{height:100%;display:block}
.balance{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:18px}
.bcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.bcard .pct{font-family:"Fraunces",serif;font-size:2.4rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1}
.bcard.k1 .pct{color:var(--c1)}.bcard.k2 .pct{color:var(--c2)}.bcard.k3 .pct{color:var(--c3)}.bcard.k4 .pct{color:var(--muted)}
.bcard h4{margin:6px 0;font-family:"Inter",sans-serif;font-size:.95rem;font-weight:800}
.bcard p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:.84rem}

.status{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px}
.scol{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:22px 24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.scol h4{margin:0 0 14px;font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:600;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.scol.settled h4::before{content:"✓";color:var(--c3);font-weight:800}
.scol.open h4::before{content:"○";color:var(--c2);font-weight:800}
.scol .row{padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.9rem}
.scol .row:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.scol .row b{display:block;margin-bottom:2px}
.scol .row span{color:var(--muted)}
footer{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:20px clamp(18px,5vw,60px) 60px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.8rem;text-align:center;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}

@media(max-width:860px){
 header{min-height:80vh}
 .plan-grid,.status,.twocol{grid-template-columns:1fr}

 #tripmap{height:380px}
}
/* TRIP PREVIEW */
.preview{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(300px,34%) 1fr;min-height:82vh;background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.pv-pane{padding:clamp(22px,4vw,54px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:16px}

Save money

  • Use foot-passenger ferry unless the Sardinia rental contract clearly allows Corsica.
  • Mix apartments with one pool villa; private pools drive the lodging band.
  • Self-cater breakfasts and beach lunches; Sardinia supermarkets are strong.
  • Pick one premium boat day; Gulf of Orosei and Bonifacio/Lavezzi should not both be private splurges.

Worth the splurge

  • Small-group Gulf of Orosei boat — the signature water day.
  • One pool stay in Ogliastra — heat + hiking makes a pool valuable.
  • Bonifacio cliff boat — short, memorable, and easy with kids if the budget gate clears.
  • Automatic car one class up — Sardinia mountain roads are tiring.

Documents

Before you go

  • ETIAS is likely required by June 2027 if the EU rollout holds; use only the official portal.
  • Bring passports for the Corsica ferry. It is an Italy-France crossing.
  • Get an International Driving Permit from AAA for Italy and keep it with the US license.

Rental cars

Counter + road

  • Do not assume you can ferry a rental car to Corsica. Get written permission or go as foot passengers.
  • Book automatic early. Mountain roads and town parking are easier with a compact SUV, not a giant van.
  • Bring/confirm the 8-year-old booster. Do not rely on a counter having one.

Beaches & permits

Timed access

  • La Pelosa and Cala Goloritze are rule-heavy. Expect caps, bookings, QR checks, and towel-mat rules.
  • Start hikes early. The heat matters more than distance in June.
  • Water shoes help in Ogliastra and Corsica pebble coves.

Food

Picky-kid strategy

  • Anchor every base near pizza/pasta. Sardinia is easy for this if you stay in towns, not isolated villas.
  • Use agriturismo carefully. Great for adults, often fixed-menu and not ideal for picky kids.
  • Gelato is the reward system. It buys patience after old towns and hikes.
